name: trace_hang
about: Does the request trace of a Deeploy request held in its endpoint reach the other oracles? The create endpoint of r1s-01 calls dAuth ('prepare') on its plugin thread and waits for the answer. For one request at a time, r1s-01's dAuth calls go through the front to load/slowdauth.py, which holds each call 45 s and then passes it to r1s-02's dAuth (the SDK's read timeout is 60 s, so the request then completes). No node code is changed. Start A: no tracked request on r1s-01 in the 30 s before. Start B: a quick tracked request (a refused delete) about 5 s before. Every oracle's saved replica is read about once a second until it shows the request answered. Starts after 300 s, as the previous release writes no trace in the first 300 s of the plugin.
